WITH payment_per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders,
    AVG(p.order_payment) AS average_payment_per_order,
    MAX(1.0, (JULIANDAY(DATE(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp))) -
              JULIANDAY(DATE(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)))) / 7.0) AS lifespan_weeks
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payment_per_order AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC, c.customer_unique_id
LIMIT 3;

    FROM ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN batsman_scored AS s

    SELECT pm.player_id, AVG(COALESCE(mr.runs, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_match

JOIN player AS p USING (player_id)
WHERE p.country_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC, p.country_name ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH delivered AS (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id

       AVG(p.payment_value) AS average_payment_value,
       MAX(CASE WHEN d.location_rank = 1 THEN d.customer_city END) AS customer_city,
       MAX(CASE WHEN d.location_rank = 1 THEN d.customer_state END) AS customer_state
FROM delivered AS d
LEFT JOIN olist_order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, d.customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2020-12-01'
),
customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM customer_nodes
    UNION
    SELECT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
monthly_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           SUM(CASE txn_type
                   WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                   WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id, date(txn_date, 'start of month')
),
month_stats AS (
    SELECT m.month_start,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN n.balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_count,
           AVG(COALESCE(n.balance, 0)) AS avg_balance
    FROM months AS m
    CROSS JOIN customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_net AS n
      ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id AND n.month_start = m.month_start
    GROUP BY m.month_start
),
-- Select the earliest month when multiple months share an extreme count.
highest AS (
    SELECT month_start, avg_balance FROM month_stats
    ORDER BY positive_count DESC, month_start ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT month_start, avg_balance FROM month_stats
    ORDER BY positive_count ASC, month_start ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', h.month_start) AS highest_count_month,
       h.avg_balance AS highest_count_month_avg_balance,
       strftime('%Y-%m', l.month_start) AS lowest_count_month,
       l.avg_balance AS lowest_count_month_avg_balance,
       h.avg_balance - l.avg_balance AS average_balance_difference
FROM highest AS h
CROSS JOIN lowest AS l;

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, DATE(insert_date) AS day,
           COUNT(*) AS entries,
           SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS capital_entries
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date >= '2022-01-01' AND insert_date < '2022-02-01'
    GROUP BY country_code_2, DATE(insert_date)
), numbered AS (
    SELECT daily.*,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2) AS insertion_days,
           JULIANDAY(day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY day
           ) AS streak_key
    FROM daily
), streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, MIN(day) AS start_date, MAX(day) AS end_date,
           COUNT(*) AS streak_days,
           1.0 * SUM(capital_entries) / SUM(entries) AS capital_proportion
    FROM numbered
    WHERE insertion_days = 9
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_key
), ranked AS (
    SELECT streaks.*, RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY streak_days DESC
    ) AS streak_rank
    FROM streaks
)
SELECT c.country_name, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.capital_proportion
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN cities_countries AS c ON c.country_code_2 = r.country_code_2
WHERE r.streak_rank = 1
ORDER BY c.country_name, r.start_date;
```

WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT o.rowid AS row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, n.pizza_name,
           o.order_time, o.exclusions, o.extras,
           CASE WHEN n.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders AS o
    JOIN pizza_names AS n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
),
ingredients AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, CAST(s.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM order_lines AS o
    JOIN pizza_recipes AS r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN json_each('[' || r.toppings || ']') AS s
    WHERE instr(',' || replace(coalesce(o.exclusions, ''), ' ', '') || ',',
                ',' || s.value || ',') = 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT o.row_id, CAST(e.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM order_lines AS o
    CROSS JOIN json_each('["' || replace(o.extras, ',', '","') || '"]') AS e
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT i.row_id, t.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS qty
    FROM ingredients AS i
    JOIN pizza_toppings AS t ON t.topping_id = i.topping_id
    GROUP BY i.row_id, t.topping_name
)
SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_name,
       o.pizza_name || ': ' || coalesce((
           SELECT group_concat(label, ', ')
           FROM (
               SELECT CASE WHEN c.qty > 1 THEN '2x' ELSE '' END || c.topping_name AS label
               FROM topping_counts AS c
               WHERE c.row_id = o.row_id
               ORDER BY (c.qty > 1) DESC, c.topping_name COLLATE NOCASE
           )
       ), '') AS final_ingredients
FROM order_lines AS o
GROUP BY o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_name, o.order_time
ORDER BY o.row_id ASC;
```

WITH film_flags AS (
    SELECT m.MID,
           CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS film_year,
           MIN(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exclusively_female
    FROM Movie AS m
    LEFT JOIN M_Cast AS c ON c.MID = m.MID
    LEFT JOIN Person AS p ON p.PID = TRIM(c.PID)
    GROUP BY m.MID, CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT film_year AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
       100.0 * SUM(exclusively_female) / COUNT(*) AS exclusively_female_pct
FROM film_flags
GROUP BY film_year
ORDER BY film_year;

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT f.film_id, f.title, ROUND(TOTAL(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM film AS f
    LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
credits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT actor_id, film_id
    FROM film_actor
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT c.actor_id, fr.title,
           fr.total_revenue / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.film_id) AS average_revenue_per_actor,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.actor_id
               ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC, c.film_id
           ) AS film_rank
    FROM credits AS c
    JOIN film_revenue AS fr ON fr.film_id = c.film_id
)
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_name,
       r.title, r.average_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN actor AS a ON a.actor_id = r.actor_id
WHERE r.film_rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, a.actor_id, r.film_rank;

WITH team_match_goals AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_id, season, home_team_goal AS goals
    FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_id, season, away_team_goal AS goals
    FROM "Match"
),
season_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, season, SUM(goals) AS season_goals
    FROM team_match_goals
    GROUP BY team_id, season
),
team_peaks AS (
    SELECT team_id, MAX(season_goals) AS peak_goals
    FROM season_totals
    GROUP BY team_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT peak_goals,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY peak_goals) AS pos,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM team_peaks
    WHERE peak_goals IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(peak_goals) AS median_highest_season_goals
FROM ranked
WHERE pos IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2);

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_plan(product_id, mth, ending_qty, qty_minimum, qty_purchase) AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, '2018-12-01', i.qty, p.qty_minimum, p.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_totals AS i
    JOIN product_minimums AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT r.product_id, b.mth,
           r.ending_qty - b.qty
               + CASE WHEN r.ending_qty < r.qty_minimum THEN r.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,
           r.qty_minimum, r.qty_purchase
    FROM inventory_plan AS r
    JOIN monthly_budget AS b
      ON b.product_id = r.product_id
     AND b.mth = date(r.mth, '+1 month')

WITH scoring_results AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM sprint_results
), constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, s.driver_id, s.constructor_id, SUM(s.points) AS points
    FROM scoring_results AS s
    JOIN races AS r ON r.race_id = s.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, s.driver_id, s.constructor_id
), driver_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(points) AS season_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING SUM(points) > 0
), ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY season_points) AS points_rank
    FROM driver_totals
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor, COUNT(DISTINCT p.year) AS season_count
FROM ranked_drivers AS d
JOIN constructor_points AS p ON p.year = d.year AND p.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = p.constructor_id
WHERE d.points_rank = 1 AND p.points > 0
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, c.name ASC
LIMIT 5;
